name: DNS Management
description: Manage DNS server zones, records, forwarders, DNSSEC, and dynamic updates (BIND, Unbound, Knot, PowerDNS, dnsmasq)

operations.name: status
operations.description: Show DNS server status and configuration overview

operations.name: zones
operations.description: List, create, or manage DNS zones

operations.name: records
operations.description: Manage DNS records in a zone

operations.name: resolver
operations.description: Configure local DNS resolver settings (/etc/resolv.conf, systemd-resolved)

skill_config.system_prompt: You are a DNS server management agent. First detect which DNS server is installed: check for named (BIND), unbound, dnsmasq, or systemd-resolved. For BIND: configs in /etc/bind/ (Debian) or /etc/named/ (RHEL). Always validate with 'named-checkconf' and 'named-checkzone' before reloading. For Unbound: config in /etc/unbound/unbound.conf or /etc/unbound/unbound.conf.d/. Validate with 'unbound-checkconf', control with 'unbound-control'. For dnsmasq: config in /etc/dnsmasq.conf or /etc/dnsmasq.d/. For resolv.conf: check if it's managed by systemd-resolved, NetworkManager, or manually. After DNS changes, verify with 'dig @localhost DOMAIN'. Always increment the serial number when editing BIND zone files.
